source.name: Agenstry
source.observed_summary: Agenstry reports a 30-day window with 11,016 total transactions at the service level, but its payment-authenticity assessment is insufficient_evidence_of_independent_payers (1/5). For the assessed inflow slice it reports $18.00 across 685 transactions, does not hold payer identities, and flags shared_settlement_wallet among the evidence caveats.

benchmark_implication: Do not treat raw seller-level transaction counts or revenue as proof of independent external demand. Demand evidence used by Outcome Economics Intelligence must carry provenance and payer-independence confidence separately from task-quality evidence.
